title_zh: 非工程师的真实抱怨，是更大的金矿
title_en: Non-Engineers' Raw Complaints Are the Bigger Gold Mine
desc_zh: 22,946 条开发者讨论（含 09-19 完整）：① 会计/护士/小房东等非工程师的重复流程痛是最大机会面；② 系统运维(7:1)、创业者(6:1)开发者工具几乎没人做；③ 职场高赞是「反辞职自保」实用主义。
desc_en: 22,946 developer discussions (incl. complete 09-19): ① non-engineers' repetitive-workflow pain (AP/handover/rent-chase) is the biggest surface; ② dev tools in sysadmin (7:1) and entrepreneurs (6:1) gaps are barely built; ③ career top-upvotes are 'anti-quit, self-protect' pragmatism.
